symptom: A candidate is fully green and mergeable, but the canonical production authority/control-plane cannot be reached reliably.
failed_or_forbidden_approaches: Bypass BG169 and merge directly merely because GitHub permits it
Create a second production authority or temporary parallel promotion route
Retry the unavailable Make control-plane repeatedly and create rate pressure
Discard a proven green candidate and rebuild solely because unrelated main commits landed
required_response: Keep the exact tested candidate SHA immutable and available
Verify CI, mergeability and absence of actual changed-path/contract/dependency conflict
Do not bypass the canonical production authority
Record the open production outcome obligation in shared memory
When the authority recovers, resume from the same candidate SHA unless a real conflict appeared
If a real overlap/conflict appeared, rebuild/rebase only the affected delta and rerun its gates
After promotion, verify exact production identity and protected runtime outcomes before PRODUCTION_GREEN
moving_main_rule: Unrelated commits on main do not invalidate a candidate. Only merge conflict, changed-path overlap, declared contract overlap or declared dependency conflict requires synchronization/rebuild.
retry_rule: On connector/control-plane 429 or resource-unavailable behavior, stop discovery/retry pressure and make one targeted retry only after new evidence or recovery.
completion_rule: A chat/run is not structurally complete while this outcome exists only in conversation text; the fingerprint, obligation, evidence and prevention must be in durable shared memory.

evidence.reason_not_promoted: canonical BG169/Make production authority unavailable; authority intentionally not bypassed

resume_condition: BG169/Make control-plane becomes reachable and candidate still has no material conflict
